fields.name: event
fields.coerce: compared with `==` to the two strings
fields.description: `"show"` sets `player.p.trades = 1`. `"hide"` sets it to `null`. Any other value does nothing and sends nothing (node/server.js:12576-12580).

confirm.note: The handler reads only `data.event`. A `null` payload throws at `data.event` (`game_error` `"ERROR!"`, node/server.js:4947-4966)

responses.name: Shown
responses.summary: Your state (`resend "nc+u+cid"`, no `reopen`). `reslot_player` rebuilt the trade entries of `slots`: `trade1` to `trade4`, each a `TradeSlotItem` (`cache_item(item, 1)` keeps `price` and `rid`) or `null`. With a merchant stand open, `slots` holds the 16, 24 or 30 slots of the stand instead, and `p.trades` has no effect.

confirm.note: `resend` with `nc+u+cid`: no `reopen`. The fields of the state are in the receive entry `player`

list.name: Hide
list.when: Hides the trade slots: sets `player.p.trades = null`.

responses.name: Hidden
responses.summary: Your state (`resend "nc+u+cid"`, no `reopen`). `reslot_player` rebuilt `slots` with no trade entries. With a merchant stand open, `slots` holds the 16, 24 or 30 slots of the stand instead, and `p.trades` has no effect.

confirm.note: `resend` with `nc+u+cid`: no `reopen`. The fields of the state are in the receive entry `player`

rows.when: `p.trades` is `null` or absent (`!= null` is false for both).
